content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Surprise

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria and document your project hours, roles, and outcomes. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess whether your background meets the standard.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led format covers the PMBOK® Guide, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Attend synchronously from anywhere, ask questions in real time, and receive comprehensive course materials you'll reference throughout your career.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, complete your PMI PMP application online and pay the associated exam fee. Be ready to provide transcripts, employment references, and documentation of your project experience. Our team provides guidance on the application portal to ensure accurate submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources—practice tests, study guides, and review sessions—to strengthen weak areas. Schedule your computer-based exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or via remote proctoring. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before you sit.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you hold the PMP for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, conferences, volunteer work, or authorship to renew. Plan early: track your PDUs, renew before expiration, and stay current with PMI's evolving standards and community.
